description: Basic Dutch company data from the Netherlands Chamber of Commerce (KVK) open High Value Dataset for an 8-digit KVK number: whether the registration is active, start date, legal form code and meaning (BV, NV, sole proprietorship, foundation...), 2-digit postcode region, and SBI activity codes (main and other activities). KVK's open set is anonymised: names and addresses are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
